title: An Overview of Large Language Models for Statisticians

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing generation probabilities of profession-related words and leadership stereotypes using paired male and female names in prompts, and evaluating distance-based metrics (e.g., projection lengths) in embedding spaces.
Comparing the probability or rate of generating toxic adjectives when prompted with terms related to different racial groups (e.g., African Americans vs. European Americans).
Evaluating outcome-based and probability-based disparities in model responses between paired demographic groups using age-related identifiers (e.g., young vs. old).
Evaluating model outputs for discrimination against specific religious groups in downstream applications.
